sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): League's ninja run, leaning forward, both arms low with the wrist blades trailing, the LEGS STEPPING IN TURN, the body bobbing with each step
sheets.weapons: THE WRIST BLADES go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): each forearm a gold bracer with two or three long silver blades; hanging DOWN along his legs unless the pale figure raises, thrusts or flings that arm - then the blades point where that forearm points. Only his own two sets of blades (no extra weapons); the big SHURIKEN stays on his back in every frame.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: one foot planted on the ground AHEAD of his hips (right); the other leg kicked up BEHIND him (left), its foot off the ground. Frame 2: the front foot still planted, now nearer under him; the back leg still up behind, its foot off the ground, starting to come forward. The two legs TAKE TURNS: the foot planted in frames 1-6 is the one kicked up behind in frames 7-8. Follow the pale figure's LEGS exactly - frames 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 have a foot off the ground; never the same leg pose in every frame.
